-- CLOSED TEST FIXTURE. Not a migration and not granted to application callers.
-- Historic confirmed links retain NULL: their reviewed fingerprints are unknown.
-- The existing RPC remains the only supported path to record a fresh review.
-- This fixture does not certify physical Storage bytes or link-evidence provenance.

alter table public.concert_unit_links
 add column confirmed_later_fingerprint text,
 add column confirmed_earlier_fingerprint text,
 add constraint concert_link_fingerprint_pair check (
  (confirmed_later_fingerprint is null and confirmed_earlier_fingerprint is null)
  or (confirmed_later_fingerprint is not null and confirmed_earlier_fingerprint is not null
   and confirmed_later_fingerprint ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$' and confirmed_earlier_fingerprint ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$')
 );

create schema concert_link_fingerprint_candidate;
revoke all on schema concert_link_fingerprint_candidate from public,anon,authenticated,service_role;
create table concert_link_fingerprint_candidate.permits(
 pid integer not null,
 transaction_id bigint not null,
 link_id uuid not null,
 primary key(pid,transaction_id,link_id)
);
revoke all on all tables in schema concert_link_fingerprint_candidate from public,anon,authenticated,service_role;

-- Prevent directly forging reviewed fingerprints or confirming/changing the
-- endpoints, relation or evidence of a confirmed link outside the reviewed
-- RPC. Existing links are not rewritten; unrelated fields retain legacy behavior.
create function concert_link_fingerprint_candidate.guard() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path=pg_catalog as $$
declare requires_permit boolean:=false;
begin
 if tg_op='INSERT' then
  requires_permit:=new.status='confirmed' or new.confirmed_later_fingerprint is not null or new.confirmed_earlier_fingerprint is not null;
 elsif tg_op='UPDATE' then
  requires_permit:=new.confirmed_later_fingerprint is distinct from old.confirmed_later_fingerprint
   or new.confirmed_earlier_fingerprint is distinct from old.confirmed_earlier_fingerprint
   or (new.status='confirmed' and (old.status is distinct from 'confirmed'
    or new.later_unit_id is distinct from old.later_unit_id
    or new.earlier_unit_id is distinct from old.earlier_unit_id
    or new.root_unit_id is distinct from old.root_unit_id
    or new.relation_kind is distinct from old.relation_kind
    or new.matching_method is distinct from old.matching_method
    or new.evidence is distinct from old.evidence));
 end if;
 if requires_permit and not exists(select 1 from concert_link_fingerprint_candidate.permits
  where pid=pg_backend_pid() and transaction_id=txid_current() and link_id=new.id) then
  raise exception 'CONCERT_LINK_FINGERPRINT_REVIEW_REQUIRED';
 end if;
 return new;
end $$;
revoke all on function concert_link_fingerprint_candidate.guard() from public,anon,authenticated,service_role;
create trigger concert_link_fingerprint_guard before insert or update on public.concert_unit_links
 for each row execute function concert_link_fingerprint_candidate.guard();

-- Keep the existing graph lock, row locks, CAS and audit behavior. Capture
-- exactly the fingerprints checked in the same transaction. Rejecting or
-- excluding a link does not overwrite the last confirmed fingerprints.
create or replace function public.review_concert_link(p_link uuid,p_version integer,p_later_fingerprint text,p_earlier_fingerprint text,p_status text,p_note text)
returns integer language plpgsql security definer set search_path=pg_catalog,public as $$
declare old_row public.concert_unit_links; updated public.concert_unit_links;
begin
 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('concert-review-graph',0));
 select * into strict old_row from public.concert_unit_links where id=p_link for update;
 if old_row.version<>p_version then raise exception 'Revisió obsoleta; torna a carregar la fitxa';end if;
 if p_status not in ('confirmed','rejected','out_of_horizon') or length(trim(coalesce(p_note,'')))<10 then raise exception 'Revisió no vàlida';end if;
 if old_row.status='confirmed' and p_status<>'confirmed' and exists(select 1 from public.concert_unit_links where earlier_unit_id=old_row.later_unit_id and status='confirmed') then raise exception 'Revisa primer els vincles dependents abans de retirar aquest';end if;
 perform 1 from public.record_units where id in(old_row.later_unit_id,old_row.earlier_unit_id) order by id for update;
 if (select source_fingerprint from public.concert_economic_source where id=old_row.later_unit_id) is distinct from p_later_fingerprint
  or (select source_fingerprint from public.concert_economic_source where id=old_row.earlier_unit_id) is distinct from p_earlier_fingerprint then raise exception 'La línia ha canviat; torna a revisar-la';end if;
 insert into concert_link_fingerprint_candidate.permits(pid,transaction_id,link_id) values(pg_backend_pid(),txid_current(),p_link);
 update public.concert_unit_links set status=p_status,review_note=trim(p_note),reviewed_at=now(),version=version+1,
  confirmed_later_fingerprint=case when p_status='confirmed' then p_later_fingerprint else old_row.confirmed_later_fingerprint end,
  confirmed_earlier_fingerprint=case when p_status='confirmed' then p_earlier_fingerprint else old_row.confirmed_earlier_fingerprint end
  where id=p_link returning * into updated;
 delete from concert_link_fingerprint_candidate.permits where pid=pg_backend_pid() and transaction_id=txid_current() and link_id=p_link;
 insert into public.concert_review_audit(kind,subject_id,before_value,after_value) values('link',p_link,to_jsonb(old_row),to_jsonb(updated));
 return updated.version;
end $$;
